Microbiome composition by diet group (MetaPhlAn 4).

* Description of the most abundant phyla, genera and species (relative abundance of the classified profile).
* Diet signatures: MaAsLin2 at species and genus level, same settings as the resistome
  (`0.-Diet_group/Scripts/03.AMR_description.Rmd`): LOG transform, prevalence ≥ 10 %,
  diet group (reference Omnivore) + sex + age + BMI + log10 depth.
  MetaPhlAn output is already relative abundance, so it is only re-normalised to 1 (TSS) and no further
  normalisation is applied in MaAsLin2.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(phyloseq)
library(patchwork)
library(Maaslin2)

table_dir <- here("2.-Microbiome", "Results", "Tables")
plot_dir <- here("2.-Microbiome", "Results", "Plots")
maaslin_dir <- here("2.-Microbiome", "Results", "Maaslin2")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(maaslin_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# Set plot themes

```{r theme}
diet_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = "#2864A5",
  "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
  "Vegan"      = "#B36B32")

taxa_palette <- c("#0F4C81", "#C49135", "#4C956C", "#A23E48", "#765D9A", "#2D6A8A",
                  "#E0A458", "#789447", "#C46D4A", "#5B5F97", "#D35D90", "#346B5B",
                  "#8E6B55", "#9A648D", "#4F6D9A")
other_color <- "#B8B8B8"

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30"),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)))
```


# Load data

```{r load data}
ps <- readRDS(here("Data", "Processed", "phyloseq_species.rds"))

# Relative abundance of the classified profile
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))

metadata <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame") %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)))
```


# Description

```{r composition helper}
# Mean relative abundance per diet group of the top_n taxa at a rank; the rest are pooled as "Other"
composition_by_diet <- function(rank, top_n) {
  melt <- ps_rel %>%
    tax_glom(taxrank = rank, NArm = FALSE) %>%
    psmelt() %>%
    select(sample_id = Sample, diet_group, taxon = all_of(rank), Abundance)

  top_taxa <- melt %>%
    group_by(taxon) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    slice_max(mean, n = top_n) %>%
    pull(taxon)

  melt %>%
    mutate(taxon = if_else(taxon %in% top_taxa, taxon, "Other"),
           taxon = factor(taxon, levels = c(top_taxa, "Other")),
           diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors))) %>%
    group_by(sample_id, diet_group, taxon) %>%
    summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(diet_group, taxon) %>%
    summarise(mean_abundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop")
}

plot_composition <- function(df, title) {
  taxa <- setdiff(levels(df$taxon), "Other")
  colors <- c(setNames(taxa_palette[seq_along(taxa)], taxa), Other = other_color)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = diet_group, y = mean_abundance, fill = taxon)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = title) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean relative abundance") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = unname(diet_colors), size = 9),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
          legend.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8))
}
```

```{r phylum and genus}
phylum_by_diet <- composition_by_diet("Phylum", top_n = 8)
genus_by_diet <- composition_by_diet("Genus", top_n = 15)

plot_composition_panel <- plot_composition(phylum_by_diet, "Phylum") |
  plot_composition(genus_by_diet, "Genus")

plot_composition_panel
```

## Top 20 species

```{r top species}
species_long <- psmelt(ps_rel) %>%
  transmute(sample_id = Sample, diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)),
            species = OTU, phylum = Phylum, abundance = Abundance)

taxa_summary <- species_long %>%
  group_by(species, phylum) %>%
  summarise(prevalence = mean(abundance > 0),
            mean_abundance = mean(abundance),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(species_long %>%
              group_by(species, diet_group) %>%
              summarise(mean = mean(abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = diet_group, values_from = mean, names_prefix = "mean_"),
            by = "species") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abundance))

top20_species <- taxa_summary %>% slice_head(n = 20) %>% pull(species)
species_levels <- rev(top20_species)

top20_summary <- species_long %>%
  filter(species %in% top20_species) %>%
  group_by(species, diet_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean = mean(abundance),
            se = sd(abundance) / sqrt(n),
            ci_low = pmax(0, mean - qt(0.975, n - 1) * se),
            ci_high = mean + qt(0.975, n - 1) * se,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species, levels = species_levels))

plot_species_abundance <- ggplot(top20_summary, aes(x = species, colour = diet_group, group = diet_group)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.68),
                width = 0.20,
                linewidth = 0.65) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean),
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.68),
             shape = 18,
             size = 3.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean relative abundance", colour = "Diet group") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")

# Phylum of each species as a coloured tile
top20_phyla <- taxa_summary %>%
  filter(species %in% top20_species) %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species, levels = species_levels))
phylum_colors <- setNames(taxa_palette[seq_along(unique(top20_phyla$phylum))], sort(unique(top20_phyla$phylum)))

plot_species_phylum <- ggplot(top20_phyla, aes(x = 1, y = species, fill = phylum)) +
  geom_tile(width = 0.9, height = 0.9, colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors, name = "Phylum") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9))

plot_top20_species <- plot_species_abundance + plot_species_phylum +
  plot_layout(widths = c(6, 0.4))

plot_top20_species
```


# Diet signatures (MaAsLin2)

```{r maaslin function}
metadata_maaslin <- metadata %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")

# Abundance table at a rank with safe feature names for MaAsLin2
abundance_table <- function(rank) {
  ps_rank <- if (rank == "Species") ps_rel else tax_glom(ps_rel, taxrank = rank, NArm = FALSE)
  abundance <- as(otu_table(ps_rank), "matrix")
  taxa <- as(tax_table(ps_rank), "matrix")[, rank]
  key <- tibble(feature = sprintf("%s_%04d", rank, seq_along(taxa)), taxon = unname(taxa))
  rownames(abundance) <- key$feature
  list(data = as.data.frame(t(abundance)), key = key)
}

run_maaslin_diet <- function(rank) {
  input <- abundance_table(rank)

  fit <- Maaslin2(
    input_data = input$data,
    input_metadata = metadata_maaslin,
    output = file.path(maaslin_dir, paste0("Diet_", rank)),
    fixed_effects = c("diet_group", "sex", "age", "bmi", "log10_depth"),
    reference = "diet_group,Omnivore",
    normalization = "NONE",
    transform = "LOG",
    min_prevalence = 0.1,
    min_abundance = 0,
    standardize = FALSE,
    plot_heatmap = FALSE,
    plot_scatter = FALSE)

  fit$results %>%
    left_join(input$key, by = "feature") %>%
    mutate(rank = rank) %>%
    relocate(rank, taxon)
}
```

```{r maaslin}
maaslin_results <- bind_rows(run_maaslin_diet("Species"), run_maaslin_diet("Genus"))

diet_results <- maaslin_results %>%
  filter(metadata == "diet_group") %>%
  mutate(contrast = paste(value, "vs Omnivore"),
         enriched_in = if_else(coef > 0, value, "Omnivore"))

diet_results %>%
  filter(qval < 0.25) %>%
  count(rank, contrast, enriched_in, name = "n_taxa")
```

```{r signature plot}
signature_data <- diet_results %>%
  filter(rank == "Species", qval < 0.25) %>%
  group_by(contrast, enriched_in) %>%
  slice_min(qval, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(enriched_in = factor(enriched_in, levels = names(diet_colors)),
         q_label = case_when(qval < 0.001 ~ "***", qval < 0.01 ~ "**", qval < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""),
         taxon = fct_reorder(taxon, coef))

plot_signature <- ggplot(signature_data, aes(x = coef, y = taxon, fill = enriched_in)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = coef - stderr, xmax = coef + stderr), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3, orientation = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(x = coef + sign(coef) * (stderr + 0.1), label = q_label,
                hjust = if_else(coef > 0, 0, 1)), size = 3, vjust = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diet_colors, drop = FALSE, name = "Enriched in") +
  labs(x = "MaAsLin2 coefficient (log2 relative abundance)", y = NULL,
       subtitle = "Up to 15 species enriched in each group per contrast, q < 0.25 (* q < 0.05, ** q < 0.01, *** q < 0.001)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

plot_signature
```

```{r save}
write_tsv(taxa_summary, file.path(table_dir, "species_abundance_summary.tsv"))
write_tsv(bind_rows(Phylum = phylum_by_diet, Genus = genus_by_diet, .id = "rank"),
          file.path(table_dir, "composition_by_diet.tsv"))
write_tsv(diet_results, file.path(table_dir, "maaslin2_diet_taxa.tsv"))

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Composition_by_diet.png"), plot_composition_panel, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Top20_species_by_diet.png"), plot_top20_species, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Diet_signature_species.png"), plot_signature, width = 12,
       height = max(5, 0.22 * max(table(signature_data$contrast)) + 2), dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
